There are 92 students altogether.
20 of them ride the school bus home together.
So, there are 92 - 20 = 72 students remaining.
5/8 of the remaining students ride their own bike home.
So, 5/8 * 72 = 45 students ride their own bike home.
The rest of the students walk home.
Therefore, the number of students walking home is 72 - 45 = 27.
</think> <answer>27</answer>
